findings.rationale: The jump security group exposes SSH over TCP/22 to the entire internet, making administrative shell access reachable from untrusted networks.
The escalation role is configured to be assumable by the jump workload and is attached to an administrative policy, enabling privilege escalation from that foothold.
The connectivity graph connects the internet to the jump security group and then to the escalation role via STS, creating a direct privilege-escalation path.
The wildcard IAM policy grants broad access across resources while the S3 bucket is configured with a public-read ACL, compounding identity overreach with data exposure.
